heroSection.heroTitle: Your Trusted Partner for Bulgarian Visa and Passport Procedures Since 2009
heroSection.heroSubtitle: We have been completing visa, passport, and citizenship applications for our clients with confidence and speed since 2009.

processSection.step1Desc: Reach us by phone, WhatsApp, or the contact form and share your request.
processSection.step2Desc: We share the required document checklist for your case and help you prepare it.
processSection.step3Desc: We carefully manage the application process, appointments, and procedures on your behalf.
processSection.step4Desc: We keep you informed until the process is complete and deliver your documents securely.

servicesSection.service1Desc: We manage your visa application process for tourist travel to Bulgaria from start to finish.
servicesSection.service2Desc: We support your D visa and residence permit applications for work, study, or long-term residence.
servicesSection.service3Desc: We provide end-to-end consulting for Bulgarian citizenship and dual citizenship applications through ancestry and other routes.
servicesSection.service4Desc: We complete the issuance and renewal of your Bulgarian passport, along with laissez-passer (pasavan) procedures, quickly and smoothly.
servicesSection.service5Desc: We handle the issuance and renewal of your Bulgarian ID card (lichna karta) on your behalf.
servicesSection.service6Desc: We arrange notarization and certified translation of your official documents through our trusted partners.

aboutSection.aboutContent: Since 2009, we have served thousands of clients with Bulgarian visa, passport, and citizenship procedures. Our experienced team meticulously follows your case on your behalf from application to conclusion. Reliability, transparency, and speed are our top priorities.

legalSection.title: Privacy Policy and KVKK Notice
legalSection.content:
Deliorman Danışmanlık (the "Company") acts as the data controller under Turkey's Law on the Protection of Personal Data No. 6698 ("KVKK").

The name, email address, and message content you share through the contact form on this website are processed to contact you, respond to your request, and inform you about our consulting services, based on your explicit consent and the necessity for the establishment or performance of a contract, as set out in Article 5 of the KVKK.

Your personal data is not shared with third parties, except where required by law, and is retained only for as long as necessary to resolve your request.

Under Article 11 of the KVKK, you have the right to learn whether your personal data is being processed, request information about it, learn its purpose and whether it is used accordingly, know the third parties to whom it is transferred domestically or abroad, request correction if it has been processed incompletely or incorrectly, and request its deletion or destruction under the conditions set out in the law.

You may contact us at deliormandanismanlik{'@'}gmail.com to exercise these rights.
